settings.heading: Good finds shouldn't be hard to find
settings.story:
RikLoot started with a simple frustration: the genuinely useful things — a clever kitchen tool, a drawer organiser that actually fits, a handmade gift that feels personal — are scattered across a hundred different places, buried under listings that all look the same.

So we built one shelf for all of it. Kitchen helpers, storage and organisers, handmade crafts, home décor, small gadgets, beauty and care, and the everyday essentials you always seem to run out of. We work with trusted makers and suppliers across India, test what we can, and only list products we'd happily use in our own homes.

Every order is packed with care and tracked from dispatch to your doorstep. And if something isn't right, we fix it — that's the whole idea behind the name: good loot, delivered honestly.

settings.heading: How an order reaches you
settings.subheading: From the moment you tap order to the knock on your door.

settings.heading: Where do you deliver?
settings.row_content: We deliver to most serviceable pin codes across India. Enter your pin code at checkout to confirm delivery to your address.

settings.heading: How long does delivery take?
settings.row_content: Orders are usually dispatched within 1–3 business days and delivered within 5–10 business days, depending on your location. See our Shipping Policy for details.

settings.heading: Can I return a product?
settings.row_content: Yes. If an item arrives damaged, defective or different from what you ordered, tell us within 7 days of delivery and we'll replace it or refund you. See our Refund & Return Policy.

settings.heading: Is it safe to pay on RikLoot?
settings.row_content: Yes. Payments are processed by secure, RBI-regulated payment gateways. We never see or store your card details.

settings.heading: How do I reach you?
settings.row_content: Use our Contact page or the email in the footer. We reply within one business day.
